rows.en: Almost there... I'm nearly fully revived!! The remaining Core Medals are... I believe...
...That's it!! They should be in Ikadevil's lab...!!
Ikadevil's lab...!? Kazari!! Are my Cores in there too!?
I'd say so!! Ikadevil was scheming something with the Core Medals, wasn't he!?
Ikadevil, you say!? So he's in this Cube too!!
Hmph, I see... Right! We're going to Ikadevil's lab!
Hah...!? You think I'd let you go!?
Tch...! Out of my way, Kazari!
Aaahahahaha...!! Come on out!
Gwaaaaaaaah!!
How do you like it? My new Yummy? Interesting, isn't it?
This thing...!! It's nothing like the Yummies we've seen before!!
Now that I've taken in Mezool's and Gamel's Cores too, I'm evolving more and more.
And soon, I'll be fully revived! Until then, I'll need you to sit tight, okay!?
Now, get 'em! I'll leave the rest to you! See ya!
Hey! We're going after Kazari! He's up ahead!
Meanwhile, at that very moment...
...First King Pandon, and now Jewel Dopant and Arms Dopant, eh?
I expected as much, but I never imagined it would come to this...
So you think so too, Terror. It seems I, too, underestimated those fellows somewhat.
Forgive me, Father. I've lost two of my subordinates as well...
Hahahaha!! Think nothing of it, Taboo. New forces are standing by, one after another.
Quite so. All our research is finally about to bear fruit.
As expected of Ikadevil. So that thing is nearly done? I look forward to it. Hahahahaha!
Do hurry along your "Plan" as well, Terror.
Of course. Garagaranda, and you, my daughter...
Enacting the "Plan" will take a little more time. Until then, I leave the heroes' extermination to you.
Understood. In that case, let us try using that.
Oh! Could it be you intend to use that "Tyrant Monster"?
No, no, not that one yet. The truth is, I've gotten hold of another interesting monster...
Oho... If you're going to use Bogarl, I have a good idea, you know?
What? And what might that be!?
Lend me your ear...
...Oh! My word! Such a secret!! Hmm, hmm... What a splendid idea!!
Father, let me take care of those heroes with my own hands...!!
Now, now, don't be so hasty. Later on, I'll give you an intriguing Dopant.
It has its quirks, but you should be able to put it to good use.
Yes, Father!! This time I'll be sure to finish them off for good.
I wonder which of you will bring down the heroes first. I look forward to it. Hahahaha!!
Kazari said the Core Medals were in Ikadevil's lab, didn't he?
Yeah. I wonder if it's around here?
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Yeah, is it around here!?
Yeah, this place is lookin' real fishy, huh?
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Yes, that's definitely what he said. Maybe it's around here...
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Yeah, looks like they should be around here.
Hold it!!
So you've shown up!! A Shocker cyborg!!
Who's there!!
What!!
Huh? Another weirdo's gone and shown up, huh?
Who's there!!
What the hell are you!!
What are you!!
Who's there!!
Who's there!!
Who's there!!
Who's there!!
Who's there!!
Who's there!!
Who's there!!
Who's there!!
I am Hiru-Chameleon!
Beyond this point lies Dr. Ikadevil's most vital research facility. I won't let the likes of you in!!
T-to think I'd fall in a place like this... You lot, fall back... We'll try again later...
Uuugh... I am truly sorry...
With the scientific might of our Shocker, reviving a kaijin is a trifling... Hm!?
Kweeeeeeh!!
What's that?
Kweeeeeeh!!
Kikiih!?

notes.note: Rider 1 line plays only if Rider 1 is in the party (Pt_Chara_Check 1 in the script). Ikadevil glossary g=m, so 'he'.
Lion-Jellyfish Yummy roar; no established roar in the glossary, used 'Gwaaaaaaaah!!' (same family as Gomora).
#0.59-60 unlabelled and off the traced script path (script jumps from #0.58 to #0.61). Inferred: #0.59 Kazari (showing off his new Yummy, 'boku'), #0.60 Ankh reacting.

#0.70-71 are '???' (silhouetted). #0.72 Garagaranda answers 'So you think so too, Terror', so #0.71 is Terror Dopant; #0.70 most likely Terror too. Referent: the heroes have beaten King Pandon, Jewel Dopant and Arms Dopant.
Taboo's 'two subordinates' = presumably Jewel and Arms Dopants from #0.70.
Vocative row; Terror's sentence continues in #0.79 (addressing Garagaranda and Taboo).
'Boukun kaijuu' = Tyrant's official title, rendered "Tyrant Monster"; the monster itself is not named here.
Ikadevil guesses Garagaranda's 'other interesting monster' is Bogal; 'ii kangae ga aru' = he has a plan for it (pays off in story_097, Bogal devouring kaiju).
Source trails off ('with these hands, the heroes...!!'); rendered as a complete plea with the trailing ellipsis kept.
'Which of you' = Garagaranda vs Taboo (the two Terror just tasked); kept as 'which of you'.

Extractor labels are shifted by one in this table: #0.1 is Ankh (rough 'Kazari no yatsu', matches CharaNameIn Ankh at MessWinSet+1), and #0.2-#0.15 is the leader block. Pt_Chara_Check order 5,4,1,2,3,15,14,13,12,11,6,7,8,9,10 = OOO, W, Rider 1, RX, Den-O, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, Wing Zero (00's slot has no row). Wording fits: #0.2 gentle 'un' = OOO, #0.5 RX, #0.6 rough = Momotaros, #0.8 polite = Mebius.
Subject 'they' = the Core Medals (restored); OOO/RX/Mebius variants keep the source's vaguer 'it' (= what they're looking for / the lab).

Leader block #0.3-#0.17, chain 1,5,4,3,2,15,14,13,12,11,6,7,8,9,10 = Rider 1 (Shocker line), OOO, W, Den-O (#0.6 Momotaros), RX, Zero (#0.8 'temee'), Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, Wing Zero, 00. 'Kaizou ningen' rendered 'cyborg' (not in glossary).
Mebius's slot uses 'nanda, omae wa' (What are you), kept distinct from 'Who's there'.

#0.23-25 unlabelled and off the traced path (the traced defeat line is #0.63 in story_097). Inferred Hiru-Chameleon throughout: #0.23 retreat order to his monsters (Kemjila/Lodora), #0.24 apology presumably to Ikadevil, #0.25 musing that Shocker can revive him, cut off by Bogal's cry. The implied 'is easy' in #0.25 rendered 'is a trifling...' before the interruption.
Bogal's monster cry (no prior roar established; Bogal elsewhere talks): 'Kweeeeeeh!!' used for both #0.26 and #0.28. Kemjila 'Kikiih!?' new.

report: 80/80 rows translated. Inferred speakers: 0560 #0.59 (Kazari), #0.60 (Ankh), 0563 #0.23-25 (Hiru-Chameleon); 0562 extractor labels off by one (#0.1 = Ankh, #0.2 starts leader block). New roars: Lion-Jellyfish Yummy, Bogal cry, Kemjila. Not in glossary: 'kaizou ningen' -> 'cyborg', 'boukun kaijuu' -> "Tyrant Monster".
